resources.name: Google Search Console
resources.description: Inspect search performance and indexing reports for a site you can verify.

free_details.limits: A Google account and permission to the property are needed. Search Console reports do not guarantee indexing, ranking or traffic.
free_details.cost_notes: Check hardware, hosting, optional services and third-party asset rights separately.

editorial.example: Verify your own site, inspect one canonical URL and compare reported indexing with the page status and sitemap inventory.
editorial.review_type: Official documentation reviewed
editorial.tradeoff: A Google account and permission to the property are needed. Search Console reports do not guarantee indexing, ranking or traffic.

resources.name: Lighthouse
resources.description: Audit a web page for performance, accessibility and developer best practices.

free_details.limits: Lab scores vary by device, network and run. An audit is not a full accessibility assessment, search ranking or real-user performance guarantee.
free_details.cost_notes: Check hardware, hosting, optional services and third-party asset rights separately.

editorial.example: Audit one public page, record the settings and fix one actionable finding. Repeat under the same conditions rather than chasing an isolated score.
editorial.review_type: Official documentation reviewed
editorial.tradeoff: Lab scores vary by device, network and run. An audit is not a full accessibility assessment, search ranking or real-user performance guarantee.
editorial.details: Audit one public page, record the settings and fix one actionable finding. Repeat under the same conditions rather than chasing an isolated score. Keep an editable source or reproducible configuration and check the output before committing to the workflow. The example is a suggested exercise, not a claim of hands-on testing.

resources.name: PageSpeed Insights
resources.description: Inspect a page using lab analysis and available real-user performance data.

free_details.limits: Some URLs have no eligible field-data sample. Scores and results depend on the page and test conditions, and are not SEO rankings.
free_details.cost_notes: Check hardware, hosting, optional services and third-party asset rights separately.
